dataset_name: NRSC/ISRO Landslide Atlas of India (2023 update)
record_count: ~80000 India-wide; Sikkim subset not separately published
format: PDF (65 MB); underlying geospatial DB served via Bhuvan
download_method: Direct HTTPS PDF download (public, no login)
data_type: Composite atlas: seasonal + event-based + route-wise inventories
resolution: Mapped from 2.5 m-30 m optical/SAR; polygon/point
license: Government of India / NRSC terms; attribution required, redistribution not granted
overlap: Superset of Bhuvan Sikkim 2011 event + 2014/2017 seasonal layers
recommended_use: Authoritative reference for provenance, methodology and district ranking; cite as metadata source
limitations: PDF only - no machine-readable attribute table; Sikkim counts not broken out per year; ends 2022

dataset_name: Bhuvan Landslide Inventory - Sikkim event-based (18 Sep 2011 earthquake)
format: WMS map layer; supporting PDF report
download_method: Bhuvan WMS GetMap / GetFeatureInfo; no public bulk shapefile export
license: Bhuvan terms of use; viewing public, redistribution restricted
overlap: Overlaps Ghosh et al. 2012 (421 landslides) and Zenodo Cartosat subset (44 features, 30 Sep 2011)
recommended_use: Anchor inventory for 2011; primary evidence layer for earthquake-triggered recurrence
limitations: Mapped as points not polygons (explicitly stated by authors, for speed); cloud-limited; extent is not the full state

dataset_name: Bhuvan Seasonal Landslide Inventory - Sikkim 2014 monsoon
record_count: NOT PUBLISHED at state level - must be counted after extraction
format: WMS map layer with Identify Features
download_method: Bhuvan WMS GetMap / GetFeatureInfo; request bulk data from NRSC if needed
license: Bhuvan terms of use; redistribution restricted
overlap: Included within Landslide Atlas of India seasonal component
recommended_use: One of only four statewide observation years; core input to recurrence denominator
limitations: No open bulk download; monsoon-season only (does not observe non-monsoon events)

dataset_name: Bhuvan Seasonal Landslide Inventory - Sikkim 2017 monsoon
record_count: NOT PUBLISHED at state level - must be counted after extraction
format: WMS map layer with Identify Features
download_method: Bhuvan WMS GetMap / GetFeatureInfo; request bulk data from NRSC if needed
license: Bhuvan terms of use; redistribution restricted
overlap: Included within Landslide Atlas of India seasonal component
recommended_use: Second statewide observation year; core input to recurrence denominator
limitations: No open bulk download; monsoon-season only

dataset_name: Bhuvan Seasonal Landslide Inventory - Sikkim 2023 season
record_count: NOT PUBLISHED at state level - must be counted after extraction
format: WMS map layer with Identify Features
download_method: Bhuvan WMS GetMap / GetFeatureInfo
license: Bhuvan terms of use; redistribution restricted
overlap: Overlaps peer-reviewed Oct-2023 GLOF/Teesta landslide documentation
recommended_use: Most recent statewide observation year; captures the Oct 2023 South Lhonak GLOF cascade
limitations: Trigger regime is mixed (monsoon + GLOF + flood-undercutting), so counts are not comparable 1:1 with 2014/2017

dataset_name: NRSC Sikkim Landslide Inventory 2016 (report)
download_method: Direct HTTPS PDF download (public, no login)
overlap: Independent of the 2014/2017 seasonal layers
recommended_use: Ingest via PDF parser for district-level 2016 counts; flag as report-derived not polygon-derived
limitations: PDF only; no geometry; cannot support cell-level hotspot or recurrence computation

dataset_name: GSI Bhusanket - Landslide Incidence Reports archive
record_count: Variable; one PDF per investigated incident
download_method: Public HTTPS; state/year form -> direct PDF links (well suited to the URL importer)
resolution: Site-specific, often with DMS coordinates in text
license: GSI / Government of India terms; attribution required
overlap: May describe the same slides that appear in NRSC seasonal layers
recommended_use: Highest-value target for the PDF branch of the importer; yields dated, described, road-referenced events for 2023-2025
limitations: Narrative PDFs; coordinates embedded in prose; coverage driven by where GSI was deployed, not by where landslides occurred

dataset_name: GSI National Landslide Susceptibility Map (NLSM) 1:50,000 - Sikkim
record_count: Raster/polygon zonation - not an event count
format: Map service; shapefile via Bhukosh / NGDR
download_method: Viewing public; bulk download requires NGDR registered login
overlap: Independent of inventories - this is a model output, not observations
recommended_use: Map layer and ML feature; never as a training label
limitations: LOGIN REQUIRED - must be fetched manually by an administrator and placed in /data/raw; the importer must NOT attempt to bypass authentication

dataset_name: GSI Landslide Inventory via Bhukosh / NGDR
organization: Geological Survey of India / Ministry of Mines
download_method: Registered login required for download (visualisation is open)
data_type: Landslide inventory + baseline geoscience layers (incl. geology)
overlap: Independent GSI mapping; expect partial overlap with NRSC inventories
recommended_use: Best single source of Sikkim geology/lithology ML features; manual admin download then local import
limitations: LOGIN REQUIRED - out of scope for automated importer; Bhukosh has had availability problems and is being superseded by NGDR

dataset_name: NDEM Geological Landslide Inventory
organization: National Database for Emergency Management (NDEM), NRSC
download_method: RESTRICTED - NDEM is an authorised-user (government) platform
overlap: Likely shares the NRSC inventory lineage
recommended_use: DO NOT SCRAPE. Request formal access via SSDMA/NDMA institutional channel for the hackathon deployment
limitations: Access-controlled; excluded from the automated importer by policy (Section 6 and 27 of the specification)

dataset_name: Multi-temporal landslide inventory for southern Sikkim (Heijenk et al.)
organization: King's College London / BGS / Durham / Exeter (Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.8169506)
districts: Southern/eastern Sikkim only; ~3000 sq km mapped extent
record_count: 440 Google Earth landslides (255 polygons + 185 points) + 44 Cartosat features (67 polygons)
format: Shapefile + CSV + mapped-extent polygon + cloud-mask polygon
download_method: Direct HTTPS download, no login; Zenodo REST API available
resolution: Google Earth imagery; Cartosat-1 stereo 2.5 m (30 Sep 2011)
overlap: Cartosat subset overlaps the NRSC 2011 earthquake inventory
recommended_use: PRIMARY starting dataset - only open, licensed, machine-readable Sikkim inventory with per-landslide year and an explicit mapped-extent polygon
limitations: Year field = year of FIRST image the landslide appears in, NOT the failure date, so it cannot be treated as an event date; southern Sikkim only; authors state it gives a general picture rather than a complete inventory; .prj declares EPSG:3857 while the description says WGS 84 - verify CRS before loading

dataset_name: Data for Landslide Susceptibility Mapping in the Sikkim Himalaya
download_method: Direct HTTPS download, no login
overlap: Unknown until unpacked
quality: B - Research dataset, but with NO metadata record
recommended_use: Download, unpack in a sandbox, inventory the contents, then re-catalogue as specific datasets
limitations: Published Apr 2026 with an empty description - no abstract, no coverage, no schema; RAR needs unrar and must pass the archive-safety checks in Section 27 (zip-slip, decompression bomb) before extraction

dataset_name: Ghosh et al. (2012) 2011 earthquake landslide inventory
organization: Tripura University / GBPIHED Sikkim Unit / GGSIPU (ISG Newsletter Vol.18 No.2)
download_method: Literature access; no data file published
resolution: IRS data + Google Earth + field survey
overlap: Same event as NRSC 1196-landslide inventory - IDEAL duplicate-detection test pair
recommended_use: Use as an independent count for validation and as a benchmark for the duplicate-detection engine
limitations: No downloadable geometry; the 421 vs 1196 discrepancy for the same event is itself an important uncertainty signal, not an error

dataset_name: NASA Global Landslide Catalog / COOLR
record_count: ~11000+ global; Sikkim subset is small (tens of records)
format: CSV / GeoJSON / Shapefile layers (nasa_coolr_reports, nasa_coolr_events); REST API
download_method: Open download and API, no login
data_type: Report-based catalogue compiled from media and disaster databases + citizen science
resolution: Location accuracy field ranges from exact to 50 km+
license: Open / public domain (NASA); cite Kirschbaum et al. 2010
overlap: Independent of all Indian sources; may duplicate GSI incidence reports
recommended_use: The ONLY source giving continuous year coverage across 2011-2025; use for the temporal trend panel and as weak labels, clearly flagged as report-based
limitations: Media-reporting bias (events near roads and towns are over-represented, remote North Sikkim under-represented); coarse location accuracy makes it unsafe for a 1 km hotspot grid unless accuracy is filtered

dataset_name: NASA Global Gridded Landslide Inventory (GGLI)
organization: NASA GSFC (Stanley et al. 2021, Frontiers in Earth Science)
record_count: Only cells containing mapped landslides are listed
download_method: Open download, no login
overlap: Merges several public catalogues, so expect duplication with COOLR
recommended_use: Direct precedent for the 1 km x 1 km hotspot grid - adopt the same 30 arc-second grid so results are externally comparable
limitations: Ends 2019; grid cells not events, so counts are not landslide counts

dataset_name: IMD high-resolution gridded daily rainfall (0.25 deg)
format: NetCDF and binary .grd, one file per year
download_method: Public HTTP POST to RF25.php with the year as payload; no login
license: IMD terms; citation of Pai et al. 2014 required
overlap: Complementary to GPM IMERG
recommended_use: Antecedent rainfall features (1/3/7/15/30-day) for the ML pipeline
limitations: SEVERE for Sikkim - at 0.25 deg the whole 7096 sq km state falls in roughly ten grid cells, so rainfall is near-constant across most of the state and cannot by itself discriminate cell-level risk; must be supplemented with IMERG and Sikkim AWS data

dataset_name: GPM IMERG precipitation
download_method: Earthdata login (free registration) then open download
overlap: Merged into IMD's GPM-gauge product
recommended_use: Primary antecedent-rainfall feature; finer than IMD grid and available in near-real-time for the future forecasting engine
limitations: Satellite precipitation is known to underestimate orographic extremes in the Himalaya; free registration means it is a manual admin fetch, not an automated import

dataset_name: NASADEM / Copernicus GLO-30 digital elevation model
download_method: Open download (Earthdata / Copernicus registration)
overlap: Zenodo 8169506 used ASTER GDEM v3 - do not mix DEMs when deriving slope
recommended_use: Slope, aspect, curvature, relief, distance-to-drainage features
limitations: 30 m is coarse for individual failure planes; voids and radar shadow in high-relief North Sikkim; slope values differ measurably between DEM products so record which DEM produced each feature

dataset_name: ESA WorldCover land cover
download_method: Open download
overlap: None
recommended_use: Land-cover feature; forest-loss proxy near recurring hotspots
limitations: Only two epochs - cannot represent land-cover change across 2011-2025; using a 2020/2021 map as a feature for a 2011 landslide is temporal leakage and must be documented

dataset_name: OpenStreetMap road network (Geofabrik India extract)
record_count: Full road graph incl. NH-10, JN Marg (NH-310)
download_method: Open direct download, no login
license: ODbL - share-alike obligations apply to derived databases
overlap: None
quality: D - Crowd-sourced but well maintained on Sikkim's major corridors
recommended_use: distance_to_road_m, road-corridor exposure, NH-10 and JN Marg analytics
limitations: Current geometry only - a road realigned after a 2013 landslide will give a wrong 2013 distance-to-road; ODbL share-alike must be respected in any published derived dataset

dataset_name: WorldPop / GHSL population grids
download_method: Open direct download, no login
overlap: Disaggregated from Census of India 2011
recommended_use: population_exposed; must be labelled DERIVED or ESTIMATED per Section 20, never OBSERVED
limitations: Modelled, not counted - these are dasymetric estimates built on the 2011 census; the 2021 census has not been conducted, so all post-2011 figures are projections

dataset_name: Sikkim administrative boundaries (district)
districts: Gangtok, Pakyong, Mangan, Namchi, Gyalshing, Soreng
download_method: Open download
overlap: n/a
quality: B - Varies by source; Survey of India is authoritative
recommended_use: Sikkim boundary filter (Section 11), district analytics, spatial join for district assignment
limitations: CRITICAL: the district geography changed on 21 Dec 2021 - East->Gangtok + new Pakyong, West->Gyalshing + new Soreng, North->Mangan, South->Namchi. Pre-2022 records carry old names, so district must be assigned by spatial join against the boundary valid at the event date, never by string matching
